aggregate_prefill_stats_tokens.boundary: sum of PrefillStats.log_input_tokens across 43 user EXTEND forwards (health-check excluded)

scheduler_wall_sum_decode.boundary: scheduler wall interval sum, separate from Event time

fpm_capture.qualification_scope: PASS for bounded accepted Falcon S1 production capture; no further FPM gates.
fpm_capture.status: PARTIAL for R17 GPU throughput (event-bound diagnostic only)

falcon_ncu_hotspot_measurements.benchmark: bench_one_batch S1 synthetic valid-vocabulary input, bs1, input1024, output64, graph keys [1,2,4], radix/piecewise disabled, static fraction .75; same warmed standalone run has separate Prefill and Decode profiler ranges. Captured 2026-10-12 on V100; NCU PID worker, helper subprocess tracked.
falcon_ncu_hotspot_measurements.capture: --target-processes all --device 0 --profile-from-start off --nvtx --nvtx-include R17_MEASURED_FORWARD --graph-profiling node --replay-mode kernel; name-filtered actual Falcon calls. NVTX is start/end around benchmark stage; CUDA graph capture occurs before it. NCU selected the intended main worker (PID is recorded in report); child tokenizer process is tracked but has no selected matching kernels.
falcon_ncu_hotspot_measurements.scope: Real full Falcon forward call path and actual kernel inputs, but values are selected kernel/grid records, not full Graph aggregate or whole Forward. Replayed NCU metrics are arithmetic means across 2-4 NCU replay records for identical kernel/grid. Decode captures CUDA Graph replay kernels from one real decode graph forward; no conversion to complete GPU-active union.

metric_notes.gpu__time_duration.sum: per-selected-kernel elapsed; Prefill CSV unit ms, Decode CSV unit us
metric_notes.dram__bytes_read/write.sum: per selected-kernel aggregate; NCU displays Mbyte
metric_notes.dram__throughput.avg.pct_of_peak_sustain: device counter as % sustained peak; not bytes/time derived across different scope
metric_notes.lts__t_sector_hit_rate.pct: L2 sector hit ratio; supported and measured
metric_notes.sm__throughput.avg.pct_of_peak_sustained: SM elapsed throughput; distinct from NVML GPU busy
metric_notes.smsp__inst_executed_pipe_tensor.avg: Tensor-pipe instruction activity; Tensor zero on decode selected kernels, nonzero on Prefill CUTLASS matmuls
metric_notes.FP32 pipe: GV100 NCU inventory did not expose smsp__inst_executed_pipe_fp32.avg in collected report; reported per-SASS fadd/fmul/ffma instruction counts as available, not relabeled FP32-only due mixed dtype instructions.
metric_notes.NCU values: Never sum time or throughput percentages across kernel types; rows are not simultaneous additive budgets.

falcon_ncu_hotspot_measurements.limitations: Prefill first 1024-token iteration of actual EXTEND call; reports include selected attention and Mamba kernels. Decode NCU launch window profile_start_step=32, but Graph kernel nodes are replayed; call path is actual Falcon decode, and all selected grids/names occur in the no-NCU decode trace. NCU replay heavily perturbs benchmark timing (e.g. instrumented throughput ~9-11 tok/s); never use instrumented TPS as service TPS. Captures did not measure whole-Graph aggregate, nonselected kernel families, or device-active union.

standalone_speed_diagnostic.source_tree: clean G017 worktree plus out-of-tree benchmark shim; no tracked source changes

prefill_input_tps.boundary: 1024 synthetic inputs / 0.28478 s synchronized standalone ModelRunner prefill

decode_output_tps_median.boundary: median single-request decode step; 64 output tokens requested

prefill_profiled_cuda_total_ms.boundary: single EXTEND bs1 toks1024 PyTorch profiler CUDA total

decode_profiled_cuda_self_sum_ms.boundary: 8 Graph decode steps Self CUDA sum, not active union

standalone_speed_diagnostic.limitations: One synthetic c1 standalone run, different request/cache/timing boundary from service matrix; not statistical service/GPU-active TPS. NCU selected real call-path kernels are recorded separately and are not whole Graph.

prior_full_graph_ncu_attempt.config: --graph-profiling graph --replay-mode kernel --profile-from-start off --launch-count 1; Torch CUDA Profiler range around Prefill
prior_full_graph_ncu_attempt.result: NCU report contains only one prefill initialization unrolled_elementwise_kernel; 81 replay passes; no serving Forward Graph row, no counters promoted.
prior_full_graph_ncu_attempt.inventory: Root metric query lists GV100 SM throughput, Tensor instructions, DRAM bytes, L2 bytes and DRAM/L2 percent-of-peak metrics; inventory is not measurement.

whole_device_nvml.limitation: Whole-device windows span six service cells, not per-request; NVML Busy is not SM throughput or HBM bandwidth.

ncu_actual_falcon_derived_kernel_fixture.limitation: Real Falcon L43 M4 operand fixture under NCU kernel replay, not live Graph. GV100 sm__throughput.avg, dram__throughput.avg, lts__throughput.avg are n/a in these reports; NCU queried metrics are supported but no new full Graph profile exists.

real_falcon_kernel_hardware_counters.limitation: selected hot kernel records only; no full Graph aggregate or GPU active union

real_graph_full_model_hardware_counters.reason: Archived G019 CUDA activity traces do not carry Graph node identity or hardware counters. No directly attributable full-model Graph NCU measurement in repository.

owner_ledger.limitation: Three-step torch.profiler windows with per-step GPU annotations; owner durations are sums, can overlap; graph node IDs absent; UNKNOWN includes unowned GEMV/GEMM. Not uninstrumented service timing.

cache_capability.observed_service: radix/hierarchical cache disabled; cached tokens 0 in measured S1 request set.
cache_capability.source: Accepted G017 tree source audit: mem_cache/registry.py selects HiMambaRadixCache for hierarchical cache + hybrid SSM; Falcon config has 44 full-attention/Mamba layers. hi_mamba_radix_cache.py builds distinct PoolName.MAMBA backup/restore transfers; hicache_storage.py documents v2 usable-prefix intersection across KV and auxiliary pools; host state pools are assembled in hybrid_cache/hybrid_pool_assembler.py.
cache_capability.L1_gpu: GPU Radix prefix cache source-supported; disabled in measured service and cached-token snapshots sum to zero. Cold/warm benefit NOT_RUN.
cache_capability.L2_host: Host KV and Mamba state backup/restore source-supported. Valid full Falcon prefix-frontier restore and runtime correctness were not executed; empirical benefit/cost NOT_RUN (not UNSUPPORTED).
cache_capability.L3_disk: Optional storage backend and HiMamba archive/prefetch hooks exist; no backend/path enabled. DISABLED/NOT_RUN; no restore bytes/time.
cache_capability.state_pair: Source exposes paired KV + Mamba state handling and prefix-hit intersection; this is capability evidence only. Full Falcon restore correctness and reuse are NOT_RUN.

remaining_metric_dispositions.full_graph_hardware_aggregate: NOT_RUN; earlier NCU graph-profiling attempt captured initialization only and was rejected. Selected actual Falcon kernel NCU is KERNEL_SCOPE.
remaining_metric_dispositions.gpu_active_union: UNSUPPORTED by retained CUDA Event data: event durations lack shared absolute CUDA timestamps; do not sum intervals as union.
remaining_metric_dispositions.pcie_h2d_d2h_bandwidth: NOT_RUN; no valid per-workload directional PCIe byte/time record retained.
remaining_metric_dispositions.cuda_launch_overhead: NOT_RUN; no isolated/attributable launch-overhead measurement retained.
remaining_metric_dispositions.safe_concurrency_above_c4: NOT_RUN; accepted S1 max_num_reqs=4 and no validated higher running-request pool headroom/config was evidenced. No c8+ point claimed safe.
remaining_metric_dispositions.request_p99: NOT_RUN / insufficient sample size: service matrix has 3 requests at c1 and 12 at c4 per cell; no qualified p99.
remaining_metric_dispositions.rtx_3090_comparison: UNRESOLVED_COMPARABILITY; historical E021 path is external and raw workload/config dataset is unavailable in the current checkout/capture store.

scheduler_lifecycle.queue_wait: PARTIAL measured in one additional S1 service capture via existing --enable-request-time-stats-logging. Ten request IDs join client TTFT to scheduler queue_duration and forward_duration; one 4K/c4 wave shows TTFT tail tracking wait-queue residence. Admission subphases, GPU first-token duration, scheduling gap, cache wait and preemption remain NOT_RUN; this is not an uninstrumented quantile authority.

lifecycle_capture.workload: single 4K/c4, 4K/c1, 1K/c4, 1K/c1 wave, 256 greedy tokens/request, radix disabled
lifecycle_capture.boundary: Scheduler wait_queue_entry_time to forward_entry_time and forward_entry_time to completion_time from ReqTimeStats. Not GPU duration. Client request-to-first-streamed output remains client TTFT. 4K/c4 queue values track the observed TTFT tail for this bounded wave.

scheduler_lifecycle.periodic_log_observation: The FPM capture service log is periodic and shows #queue-req 0 at sampled Prefill/Decode logs, but samples are not exhaustive or joined to HTTP request IDs; cannot rule out short queue waits.

4k_c4_tail.baseline: Existing S1 service p95 TTFT 14021.0 ms (12 request samples across 3 waves); observed TTFT includes queue.
4k_c4_tail.follow_up_capture: /mnt/data/pc01/sglang-v100-migration/experiments/E026/r17-s1-lifecycle-client.jsonl and /mnt/data/pc01/sglang-v100-migration/logs/r17-lifecycle-reqtime.log; 10/10 request IDs joined to ReqTimeStats. In a new 4K/c4 wave, queue durations were 0.20, 8367.65, 16991.85, 25620.53 ms; corresponding client TTFT 1191, 9815, 18452, 27070 ms. 4K/c1 matched queue 0.24ms and TTFT 1198ms. Cache disabled/0 cached tokens. This directly shows first-token tail tracks SGLang wait-queue residence in this one capture; forward_duration is request lifecycle span, not isolated GPU active time.
4k_c4_tail.limits: one 4K/c4 and one comparison wave; not a new quantile authority and not enough to explain all historical waves.

scheduler_lifecycle.saturation: Only c1/c2/c4 bounded 256-output S1/Candidate cells exist for common workload; c8+ scan NOT_RUN. Higher points were not treated as safe because no validated live KV/Mamba pool headroom or running-request limit above accepted max_num_reqs=4 was recorded.

required_answers.answer: Measured service output TPS is reported by workload; request-aligned Event ratios are diagnostics, not qualified GPU active TPS.
Service S1/Candidate TTFT/ITL/E2E p50/p95 measured at small n; p99 unsupported.

Whole-device NVML busy measured and actual Falcon Prefill/Decode selected-kernel NCU counters include SM/Tensor/FP16/SASS/DRAM/L2/efficiency metrics; full-Graph aggregate and complete active time remain unavailable.
G020 trace-window owner table exists; UNKNOWN and no Graph-node mapping remain.
10/10 request-ID join and one 4K/c4 queue-residence capture; admission subphases, GPU-time separation, scheduling gaps/cache wait remain unmeasured.
Measured service disabled radix cache and observed zero cached tokens; causal cache-vs-prefill benefit not run.
No safe c8+ saturation scan; only c1/c4 measured.

No raw RTX 3090 workload/config dataset found in current checkout or searched capture store; historical E021 result is external to this environment. Workload, actual batch, cache and timing boundaries cannot be reconciled, so no direct ratio is calculated.

Selected actual Falcon hot-kernel NCU and G020 attribution do not form an exclusive uninstrumented whole-forward owner budget. No optimization owner or recoverable-time estimate is defensible; the single 4K/c4 queue-tail finding is bounded evidence, not a general optimization budget.
